description: GuardDuty S3 finding indicating public exposure or active exfiltration of bucket data. Excludes the Low-severity config-drift findings (AccountBlockPublicAccessDisabled/BucketBlockPublicAccessDisabled) and Discovery:S3/* (recon, not exposure/exfiltration) -- left to the catch-all instead.
playbook: GuardDuty has flagged this S3 bucket as either publicly exposed or subject to exfiltration-pattern access. Public access has been blocked automatically. Review the bucket's contents for sensitive data, check CloudTrail data events for the access pattern GuardDuty flagged, and treat as a potential data breach if exfiltration-family. For a stricter posture (also blocking legitimate cross-account access), rewrite response_module to quarantine_s3_bucket.
_sync_note: If this rule's activity_name pattern changes, update 028_guardduty_catchall.json's matching not_matches condition -- see docs/detection-rules.md#keeping-this-in-sync.
